sinopsis.es: En el Delta del Paraná nada es exactamente lo que parece: Tigre no es un tigre, sino un yaguareté, y los exclusivos countries que prometen convivir con la naturaleza avanzan sobre ella. Mientras el centro turístico exhibe una imagen idílica, un grupo de mujeres sostiene, de forma voluntaria, una tarea de reciclaje en un barrio sin recolección de residuos ni acceso al agua corriente. Un retrato de las profundas desigualdades del territorio.
sinopsis.en: The Parana river’s delta is not quite what it seems: Called Tigre (tiger), it is wrongly named after tigers given that yaguaretés (jaguars) were there instead. The exclusive gated communities promising a life in nature are actually eating away at it. While the touristic spot shows an idyllic picture, a group of women volunteer at a recycling center because there’s no garbage collection or running water in their neighborhood. A tale of the profound inequalities on the land.
